cpu_accounting: sum of parent and caller thread CPU clocks; sampled on each live thread
scope: Fixed u64 increment and checked result per operation, one outstanding request per caller. A: shared object with Mutex / atomic diagnostic; B: the SAME workers exchange queued messages or single-outstanding mailboxes and service incoming requests while awaiting their own reply; ZERO extra service/coordinator threads. Independent objects are assigned to the next worker in a ring; the shared object belongs to worker 0. One worker is the degenerate local-delivery control. C: production Request/Reply/Event/Pool transport with its retained View. C excludes interpreter, Linux/VFS, global stop/join/commit/dispatch: a transport lower bound, not full coordinator cost. No thread/channel/mapping initialization in the measured interval; caller completion and thread join are included. Parallel ns/operation is inverse aggregate throughput, not individual call latency. This is not guest performance or an iPad prediction.

header.scope: fixed u64 counter; production RPC transport only; no Linux/VFS/interpreter/checkpoint cost
